result.title: Optimization Techniques for Solving the Minimum Red--Blue Separating Set Problem with an Application to Human--AI Text Separation
result.summary: We study the so-called Minimum Red''Blue Separating Set Problem (MRBSSP) which arises from computational geometry. In particular, we propose a compact Set-Cover ILP formulation, safe preprocessing rules, a Greedy Randomized Adaptive Search Procedure (GRASP), and two exact approaches: one is based on Logic-Based Benders Decomposition (LBBD) approach, and the second represents a novel Branch-and-Benders-Cut (BBC) approach. These two exact approaches are compared to ILP--alongside GRASP and the Variable Neighborhood Search (VNS) from literature. Experiments on 250 random graphs with up to 500 vertices reveal complementary strengths: ILP yields the best feasible solutions, LBBD provides the strongest lower bounds and smallest mean optimality gap, and BBC certifies optimality most frequently. We further introduce an NLP application distinguishing human- and AI-generated texts through vocabulary-based graph features. On 42 instances, BBC achieves the smallest mean optimality gap, certifying 16 optima, while GRASP outperforms VNS. Structural analysis of optimal vocabulary separators identifies 113 mandatory and 151 replaceable features across 272 tests, highlighting substantial variability among optimal solutions. Overall, our results demonstrate the effectiveness of complementary optimization strategies and the interpretability of optimal vocabulary-based discrimination.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究计算几何中的最小红蓝分离集问题，提出紧凑集合覆盖 ILP、预处理规则、GRASP 启发式以及 LBBD 与 Branch-and-Benders-Cut 两种精确算法，并在随机图上对比，另将其用于基于词汇图特征区分人类与 AI 生成文本。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“必选/可替换特征”分析可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与贡献分配提供概念类比，但仅有词汇图特征分离文本的应用，与视觉多模态推理无直接联系，需核查其最优解非唯一性的刻画方式是否有可迁移之处。
